baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins the belief verb at word 1, public saying at word 4, and the migrant noun at word 6 to the Lordward destination and closing names.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling assent is externalized as a spoken, house-to-house movement toward the Lord; might supplies protection and wisdom supplies a fitting order for the move.

activation_trace.role: Assent in which the heart settles supplies the inward commitment that departure embodies.
Audible utterance makes the migrant stance public rather than merely inward.
Departure from one abode to another supplies the bodily and spatial enactment of trust.
Owning and governing lordship makes the destination an agency rather than a coordinate.
Strength and inviolability supply protection against the costs of departure.
Right-hitting knowledge makes the movement purposive rather than impulsive.

changed_reading.before: A believer assents, then a traveler reports a change of place.
changed_reading.after: The assent becomes public and bodily: trust takes the form of leaving toward capable, discerning lordship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dative relation in the belief clause and the directional construction toward 'my Lord' flank the migrant noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus stages linked relations: Lot entrusts himself to a human bearer of truth, while migration severs a prior attachment and redirects ultimate belonging toward the Lord who owns and cultivates.

activation_trace.role: Secure trust supplies the positive bond formed in the first clause.
Severance and separation supply the negative side of changing allegiance.
Lordship supplies the new center of possession, authority, and belonging.
Cultivation and completion make reattachment formative rather than merely protective.

changed_reading.before: Migration is chiefly loss of a former place or tie.
changed_reading.after: Severance is paired with reattachment: human trust opens onto being owned, tended, and completed by the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence distinguishes a spoken claim of belief from belief exposed to assay, realized truth, and coercive pressure; the focus departure becomes a visible proving action rather than an add-on to assent.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent is the commitment whose quality the context tests.
Actual relocation supplies the observable form taken by the claimed belief.
Assaying metal or a person turns the opening claim of belief into a demand for demonstrated quality.
Realizing a promise in action supplies the criterion by which the focus movement reads as truthful belief.
Exertion under hardship supplies the social pressure against which allegiance must become action.

structural_cues: 29:2 denies that saying 'we believe' will simply be left alone, and 29:3 contrasts realized truth with falsehood.
29:8 places strenuous pressure inside a close family relation and refuses redirected allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, truth-in-action, and coerced allegiance; I infer that the focus migration is a proving action of its belief, while it could instead be a later consequence rather than the test itself.

changed_reading.before: Lot's belief is an inward or verbal acceptance followed by a separate travel notice.
changed_reading.after: Belief is assayed by whether it can leave, speak, and bear relational pressure; migration is the belief's tested body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding Noah sequence places prolonged staying beside rescue by separation in a vessel; against that contrast, wise Lordward migration is a matter of fitted timing, not a rule that movement is always more faithful than remaining.

activation_trace.role: House-to-house departure supplies the focus mode of faithful spatial change.
Discerning wisdom supplies the calibration between staying and leaving.
Long residence supplies a faithful mode of sustained presence rather than immediate exit.
Release by separation marks the point at which remaining gives way to rescue.
A vessel cutting the water supplies the material means of separation and passage.

structural_cues: 29:14 reports extended staying, 29:15 shifts to rescue in a vessel, and 29:16 then opens the Abraham sequence that reaches the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staying, separating rescue, and then migration under wisdom; I infer a contrastive timing model, while the Noah and Abraham sequences may simply present distinct missions without prescribing a shared timing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Migration proves faith because movement is intrinsically preferable to staying.
changed_reading.after: Faithfulness has no fixed spatial technique: wise timing can require long presence, then a separating passage, and here a Lordward departure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence moves from attempted burning through divine extraction, then exposes idol-mediated mutual affection as future disavowal and expulsion; Lot's trust and the Lordward departure form a durable counter-affiliation after rescue rather than a flight designed to manufacture safety.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the new interpersonal bond formed after collective hostility.
Severance supplies the break from an affection network that cannot endure.
Lordship supplies the durable authority to which the broken social bond is redirected.
Inviolable strength interprets the prior rescue as demonstrated capacity, not abstract reassurance.
Fire and flame supply the terminal violence of the former community's response.
Extraction by separation supplies a completed rescue before the migration declaration.
Mutual affection supplies the social adhesive organized around the idols.
Disavowal and renunciation expose that adhesive as unable to preserve allegiance.
Expulsion under anger supplies the final reversal of the apparent mutual bond.

structural_cues: 29:24-26 is an uninterrupted movement from lethal response, to divine rescue, to the forecast collapse of worldly affection, to Lot's trust and the migration declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attack, prior rescue, failed affection, new trust, and departure; I infer a transfer from a collapsing social shelter to Lordward affiliation, while the adjacency may be narrative sequence without a full causal claim.

changed_reading.before: Persecution causes a believer to escape and seek a safer place.
changed_reading.after: Rescue is already supplied; migration answers that rescue by leaving a self-canceling affection system and building a counter-bond ordered toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate aftermath turns severance into propagation: the migrant is followed by gift, spreading offspring, prophecy, book, and recompense, while both the dominant cultivation branch and the split growth branch of 'Lord' make the move resemble transplantation rather than depletion.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the apparent loss or uprooting that the following proliferation reverses.
Cultivation by stages supplies the formative agency behind post-migration increase.
The packet's split root branch of nourishment and growth intensifies the transplantation mechanism.
Gift without exchange supplies increase that is received rather than secured by the migrant.
Small units spreading outward turn loss of origin into distributed continuity through descendants.
Prophetic mediation supplies a transmitted vocation within the new growth.
Ordered writing supplies durable textual continuity beyond the migrant's single life.
Recompense for work frames the resulting increase as an answered cost.

structural_cues: 29:27 immediately follows the migration declaration with gifts, descendants, prophecy, book, and reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate loss-to-increase sequencing and a cultivation/growth split under the focus root; I infer a transplantation arrow, while 29:27 may enumerate favor after migration without saying each gift was caused by it.

changed_reading.before: Migration relinquishes home, continuity, and accumulated social capital.
changed_reading.after: Lordward uprooting becomes transplantation: what is left behind is answered by distributed descendants, vocation, text, and recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lot first appears as the one who trusts; the following unit gives him his own public saying and then a direct Lord-addressed request for aid, so received trust develops into independent speech and action.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies Lot's initial receptive relation.
Audible speech to his people supplies Lot's later independent public voice.
A second utterance shifts that public voice into direct petition.
Direct address to the Lord shows the trusted message terminating in divine, not merely human, allegiance.
Aid that supports and makes manifest supplies the requested capacity for Lot's own mission.

structural_cues: 29:28 explicitly gives Lot speech to his people, and 29:30 gives him a Lord-addressed plea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Lot's initial trust followed by his own speech and petition; I infer apprenticeship or transmission of agency, while the later mission could arise independently rather than through the focus relation.

changed_reading.before: Lot is a follower who accepts another speaker's claim.
changed_reading.after: His trust is generative reception: it matures into his own public address, Lordward petition, and contested agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider-house comparison makes adopted protectors into fabricated shelter and declares that shelter structurally weak; the exact return of 'the Mighty, the Wise' then turns the focus migration into an exchange of houses and protector systems, not mere homelessness.

activation_trace.role: Movement from one abode to another supplies the house-exchange frame.
Owning lordship supplies a protector whose relation is not fabricated by its dependents.
Strength and inviolability supply the positive structural opposite of a weak shelter.
Discerning wisdom supplies the judgment that distinguishes sound from unsound refuge.
Love, support, and protective alliance make the adopted patrons function as a social shelter.
The web-building creature supplies the material maker of the comparison's constructed refuge.
Shelter and dwelling supply the structure whose protective adequacy is under audit.
Loss of strength supplies the diagnosed failure of the fabricated protector-house.
The repeated title explicitly restores inviolable strength after the weak-house image.
The repeated wisdom title closes the shelter comparison with discerning evaluation.

structural_cues: The exact closing pair at 29:26 recurs at 29:42 immediately after the weak spider-house comparison.
The focus migration names both an abandoned abode-pattern and a personal destination: 'to my Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration between abodes, adopted protectors, a weak house, and the exact divine-name reprise; I infer that the reprise reads the focus destination as the antithesis of fragile shelter, while the repeated formula could also be a general closure.

changed_reading.before: The migrant gives up a house and invokes divine protection during displacement.
changed_reading.after: Migration is a shelter audit: it abandons a protector-house whose structure cannot bear reliance for lordship combining effective power with right judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later believer sequence supplies a full migration architecture: constricted location opens into wide earth, the displaced are given lodging, reliance rests on their Lord, and provision is supplied even to creatures that do not carry it.

activation_trace.role: House-to-house relocation supplies the concrete practice generalized by the later address.
Lordship supplies the one responsible for destination, protection, and provision.
Spatial breadth against constriction makes relocation available as a repeatable act of worship.
Being established in an abode answers the migrant's loss of lodging with divinely assigned settlement.
The repeated Lord relation identifies who bears responsibility across displacement.
Reliance and entrustment supply the migrant's posture when outcomes cannot be carried personally.
Visible carrying supplies the logistical burden explicitly denied as the basis of creaturely provision.
Allotted giving supplies the provision that makes uncoupling from a fixed place materially thinkable.

structural_cues: 29:56 addresses believers with the width of God's earth, 29:58 promises lodging, 29:59 names Lord-reliance, and 29:60 answers anxiety about carried provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a consecutive address about space, lodging, reliance, and provision; I infer that these form infrastructure for the focus migration, while each statement can also stand as a general promise without direct logistical reference to 29:26.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports one exceptional person's risky relocation.
changed_reading.after: It prototypes a repeatable believer practice: leave spatial constriction, rely on the Lord rather than carried reserves, and expect re-housing and allotted provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later journey passes through crisis-purity and rescue 'to the dry land' but terminates in renewed association; set against 'to my Lord,' it makes the quality of migration depend on the allegiance named as destination, not merely successful landing.

activation_trace.role: Transfer between abodes supplies the journey whose endpoint must be evaluated.
Lordship makes the focus endpoint an enduring relation rather than a terrain reached.
Exclusive purification from association supplies the intense but temporary crisis orientation.
Rescue by separation supplies a successful passage that nevertheless does not secure fidelity.
Dry land supplies the merely environmental endpoint explicitly reached after rescue.
Association with God supplies the reversal that occurs once the environmental destination is secured.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from exclusive crisis devotion through rescue 'to the dry land' and immediately back to association; the focus instead directs movement 'to my Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two directional journeys with sharply different allegiance outcomes; I infer that their destinations explain the contrast, while the later reversal may diagnose the travelers rather than the semantics of destination itself.

changed_reading.before: Migration succeeds when danger is escaped and safe terrain is reached.
changed_reading.after: A landing can end sincerity; Lordward migration succeeds by sustaining its relational direction beyond changing terrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise gives guidance into plural paths after strenuous engagement; the focus declaration can therefore name a destination-vector before possessing an itinerary, with routes disclosed in the act of striving.

activation_trace.role: Departure supplies committed movement before the route is specified.
The Lord supplies a stable directional endpoint despite an unstated itinerary.
Exertion under difficulty supplies the movement-condition under which direction becomes route.
Gentle indication toward a way supplies route-disclosure rather than a map possessed in advance.
Extended traversable paths pluralize the practical forms that one Lordward vector may take.

structural_cues: The focus names only a personal destination, while the surah's final ayah explicitly links striving with being guided into plural paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the striving-to-guidance arrow at 29:69; I infer that it completes the focus's destination-without-route pattern, while the final promise can apply broadly without referring back to this migration.

changed_reading.before: The migrant knows a route and announces the journey it will follow.
changed_reading.after: The declaration commits to a Lordward vector before route possession; strenuous movement is where the plurality of viable paths becomes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant q-l-l mapping under the surface q-w-l verb; it remains anchored because its rising, bearing, and departing image sits directly beside the explicit migrant noun. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant echo and must not translate the speech verb itself as 'departed.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus speech verb at word 4 immediately introduces the migrant noun at word 6, and the packet explicitly gives that verb a secondary q-l-l target.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary audible saying preserves the actual syntactic function of the focus verb.
The split image of lifting, bearing, rising, and a people departing makes the declaration itself echo the first motion of migration.
Explicit transfer from one abode to another keeps the split-root echo visibly tethered to the focus construction.

changed_reading.before: The saying only reports a migration that begins elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance is already a lifting-off: public declaration performs the first increment of the departure it names.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it projects later household partition and residual trace back onto a brief belief-and-migration formula; it remains anchored in the focus roots of trust and separation and in Lot's later extraction. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial-social pattern, not as a universal rule about households or salvation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Lot's trusting relation at word 1 and the separation image in the migrant noun at word 6 become legible against his later household's divided extraction.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the alignment that precedes later rescue.
Separation supplies the partitioning action through which inherited attachments are tested.
Extraction by separation supplies the later rescue pattern around Lot.
Nearness and belonging supply the intimate group that rescue does not treat as mechanically indivisible.
A remainder left after others pass supplies the household exception and residue.
An effect preserved after departure turns the emptied place into a lasting trace.
A visible sign supplies the legibility of what separation leaves behind.

changed_reading.before: Faith and migration transfer a household or social unit intact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Lordward separation can repartition intimate belonging: some are extracted, one remains, and the vacated setting becomes a readable residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it pivots between the security and assent branches of the same root across migration and the secure-sanctuary scene; it remains anchored in the focus belief verb and explicit departure. Downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical-structural inversion, not claim that external safety is suspect or that every departure proves true belief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the a-m-n root at word 1 with leaving an abode at word 6, while 29:67 groups a secure sanctuary and belief in falsehood under the same root occurrence record.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted repose supply the safety-field paradoxically joined to departure in the focus.
Leaving one abode for another prevents security from being equated with immobility.
A bounded sanctuary supplies external spatial protection.
The shared occurrence record includes the secure sanctuary at word 6, supplying settled safety.
The same occurrence record includes belief at word 12, supplying assent whose object can be false.
Rapid snatching outside the sanctuary supplies the threatening perimeter that makes external safety vivid.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the object into which assent is misdirected despite spatial security.

changed_reading.before: Faith is a movement into safety, and secure dwelling confirms correct alignment.
changed_reading.after: Lot's trust can require leaving a social shelter, while external sanctuary can coexist with assent placed in falsehood; true allegiance and spatial security are separable.

strongest_changes: The immediate rescue and collapse of idol-mediated affection turn migration into post-deliverance counter-affiliation, not merely escape.
The exact reprise of 'the Mighty, the Wise' after the weak spider-house image turns the focus into an audit of protector-houses.
The wide-earth, lodging, reliance, and provision sequence generalizes the focus into a repeatable architecture for displacement.
The final striving-to-paths promise makes 'to my Lord' a destination-vector held before any route is possessed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made directional and structural echoes more activating than broad themes: false mutual affection versus durable trust, house-to-house migration versus the weak house, 'to my Lord' versus arrival 'to dry land,' and security versus belief within the same a-m-n root-field.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not settle the antecedent of the subject of the migration declaration, so the agency-transmission model relies on sequence rather than a resolved pronoun.
Immediate narrative adjacency supports but does not prove that migration causes the gifts and lineage of 29:27.
The q-w-l to q-l-l departure echo and the security inversion are deliberately retained as packet-licensed, form-distant readings rather than lexical translations.
